# oblique_user (Data Source)

A user represents a human user in the directory.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up an existing Oblique user by email address. Useful when you want
# to reference a user that is managed outside of this Terraform configuration
# (e.g. synced from an identity provider or created manually in the UI).
#
# The user with the given email must already exist in the Oblique instance;
# the data source is resolved during plan and will fail otherwise.
data "oblique_user" "manager" {
  # If you know the email of the user, you can use the user data source.
  email = "manager@example.com"
}

# Use the data source to reference the user in other resources.
resource "oblique_group" "managers_reports" {
  display_name = "Manager's Reports"
  reporting = {
    manager = data.oblique_user.manager.name
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `email` (String) Primary email of the user.
- `name` (String) Format: `users/{id}`

### Read-Only

- `create_time` (String) Create and update timestamps.
- `delete_time` (String) Users can only be soft-deleted to preserve logs and history.
- `direct_report_count` (Number) Number of direct reports to this user.
- `display_name` (String) Primary display name of the user.
- `id` (String) The ID is a computed type that always matches 'name'.
- `last_login_time` (String) The time the user last logged in. Not set if the user has never logged in.
- `login_created` (Boolean) Whether the user was created by signing in, rather than by an integration.
- `manager` (String) Optional manager of the user.

Format: `users/{user}`
- `picture_uri` (String) URI for the user's profile picture. This can either be an `https://` scheme, or an absolute path (`/imgs/foo.png`).
- `secondary_emails` (List of String) Additional emails of the user. These are in addition to the primary email.
- `title` (String) Self reported role. "VP of Engineering", "Senior Frontend Engineer", "Engineering Director, Frontend".
- `total_report_count` (Number) Number of total reports to this user.
- `update_time` (String)
